typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Modified as date,
		Grid as string,
		{Media Type 1} as string,
		{Media Type 3} as string,
		{Modified By} as string,
		{Media Type 2} as string,
		{Room   Zone} as string,
		Created as string,
		{CPSM Validated} as string,
		{Total Quantity Found} as string,
		{Site Alias} as string,
		{Site Type} as string,
		ID as string,
		Notes as string,
		{Created By} as string,
		{Time and Date of Completed Sweep} as date,
		{Forecasted Sweep Date} as date,
		{Reason Not Complete} as string,
		{Sweep Complete} as string,
		{Quantity Found(Media Type 1)} as string,
		{Quantity Found(Media Type 2)} as string,
		{CPSM Validated Time Stamp} as date,
		{Sweeper 1} as string,
		{Sweeper 2} as string,
		{Quantity Found(Media Type 3)} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Modified as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Grid as string,
		MediaType1 as string,
		MediaType3 as string,
		ModifiedBy as string,
		MediaType2 as string,
		RoomZone as string,
		Created as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CPSMValidated as string,
		TotalQuantityFound as string,
		SiteAlias as string,
		SiteType as string,
		id as string,
		Notes as string,
		CreatedBy as string,
		TimeDateCompletedSweep as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ForecastedSweepDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ReasonNotComplete as string,
		SweepComplete as string,
		QuantityFoundMediaType1 as string,
		QuantityFoundMediaType2 as string,
		CPSMValidatedTimeStamp as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Sweeper1 as string,
		Sweeper2 as string,
		QuantityFoundMediaType3 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Modified,
		Grid,
		MediaType1 = {Media Type 1},
		MediaType3 = {Media Type 3},
		ModifiedBy = {Modified By},
		MediaType2 = {Media Type 2},
		RoomZone = {Room   Zone},
		Created,
		CPSMValidated = {CPSM Validated},
		TotalQuantityFound = {Total Quantity Found},
		SiteAlias = {Site Alias},
		SiteType = {Site Type},
		id = ID,
		Notes,
		CreatedBy = {Created By},
		TimeDateCompletedSweep = {Time and Date of Completed Sweep},
		ForecastedSweepDate = {Forecasted Sweep Date},
		ReasonNotComplete = {Reason Not Complete},
		SweepComplete = {Sweep Complete},
		QuantityFoundMediaType1 = {Quantity Found(Media Type 1)},
		QuantityFoundMediaType2 = {Quantity Found(Media Type 2)},
		CPSMValidatedTimeStamp = {CPSM Validated Time Stamp},
		Sweeper1 = {Sweeper 1},
		Sweeper2 = {Sweeper 2},
		QuantityFoundMediaType3 = {Quantity Found(Media Type 3)}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
